description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a Canadian quick-service pizza chain offering pizza by the slice and whole pies for takeout and delivery. The menu includes classic and specialty Feast pizzas alongside a gluten-free cauliflower crust option, making it a flexible stop for cyclists with dietary needs. As a high-turnover slice shop, it offers a fast, affordable hot meal option on the road.
